write_up: You moved from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply, with a B.S. in Accounting and accounting software on your resume. It's common to list accounting duties this way, but these lines don't yet distinguish your work from other staff accountants in a pile.

The purchase order line is your clearest: matching orders to receipts names a task a recruiter can picture. In the current role, the close, reconciliations and audit need that same detail about your part and how much work you handle.
Let's start with the month-end close line, then work through the other Staff Accountant duties. Add the accounts, tasks and volumes you can confirm. Keep the tools and degree visible.
